# Every documented command provides help without requiring an initialized board.
exec weft$exe init --help
stdout 'Usage: weft init'
! stderr .+
exec weft$exe list --help
stdout 'Usage: weft list'
exec weft$exe show --help
stdout 'Usage: weft show'
exec weft$exe find --help
stdout 'Usage: weft find'
exec weft$exe recent --help
stdout 'Usage: weft recent'
exec weft$exe add --help
stdout 'Usage: weft add'
exec weft$exe start --help
stdout 'Usage: weft start'
exec weft$exe move --help
stdout 'Usage: weft move'

stdout 'Usage: weft reopen'
exec weft$exe done --help
stdout 'Usage: weft done'

stdout 'Usage: weft reorder'
exec weft$exe meta --help
stdout 'Usage: weft meta'
exec weft$exe sync --help
